p.i: Arridét, faciémque nouam nemus induit omne, Pratáque, ripaque, atque si symbrifera cenualles Omnia dum pubent, & dum noua temporis ætas Ad noua sel mutas inuitat carmina rupes, Nil à me, Theodore, feres? tacitúmne relinquam Te dulcésque tuas, dulcis Theodore, camœnas? Nil tibi, Beza, canam? quum formosissimus annus Dulcia iam faciles reuocarit ad otia musas? Queis nunc & Viridis pubent smbracula dumi, Et Viridis dumeta lupus qui garrula circum Voluitur, & densam texit cantantibus smbram, Vicinos frutices, aut ramos arboris alta Prensans capreolis, manibúsque tenacibus instat Luxurians, seseque intra supráque propagat.
Aspicis st gelida Viridique per omnia nube Serpat, & smbrofum foliis nigrantibus arcum Contexant implexa lupo siburna sequaci?

Ergo ego nūc referá syluas, hederamq; sirente, Gramineque & corylis muscosi fornicis smbram, Sicubi saxa madent stillantibus humida guttis, Sicubi rorantes nigra inter marmora tophi Illacrymant gelido frondosa ꝛspis in antro? Vatibus ó gratas sedes! ꝛefcet amne per smbras Densarum salicum liquido pede lene sonantis Murmur aqua, & sitreo crepitátes fonte lapillos, Dum noua purpureos interuiret herba colores, Plurimáque in florem sulgo sese induit arbos? An memore quam multa scnant sirgulta canoris Vocibus? st nunquam plures rear esse nec sllos

page.notes: Several letters in the long lines are doubtful, notably the Viridis/Virides forms and the s/s-like initial letters in "symbrifera", "silentes" and "smbram"; the line "Concentu" is set apart at the right and the last word may be cut off. The printed long s is read as s. Ornamental initials (e.g. the "Ā" of Arridet and "E" of Ergo) are large woodcut or decorated letters. Some words in the lines near "Ergo ego" are doubtful and marked only in the notes, not in the text.
